settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately and is remembered for future visits.
settings.aboutBlurb: TikZard is a local-first JSXGraph workbench: everything renders right in your browser.
settings.aboutLocal: No server, no account — your drawings and chat sessions live only on this device.
settings.aboutAgent: The AI assistant is bring-your-own-key: credentials stay in this browser and connect straight to the providers you choose.
settings.maxVersionsHint: Oldest snapshots are dropped when a document exceeds this limit.

documents.importFailed: Some files could not be imported.

workbench.hint: Everything renders locally in your browser — no server, no network.
workbench.annotateAttached: Annotated picture staged in the assistant composer

agent.title: AI Assistant
agent.systemPromptHint: The base system prompt sent to the AI assistant in every new session; the answer-language instruction follows the interface language. When you send a message, the current JSXGraph source is also appended so the model can see your drawing.
agent.noModelsHint: No models available. Configure and verify a provider in settings first.
agent.chatPlaceholder: Ask the assistant… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline, Ctrl+Enter for a new chat)
agent.annotatedPrompt: Analyse the annotated picture and modify our JSXGraph drawing accordingly.
agent.imageModelNoVision: The selected model cannot see images — pick a vision-capable model first.

image.unsupportedType: Unsupported image type — use PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF.
image.tooLarge: That image is too large — the limit is 8 MB.

agent.contextOverflowRetry: Model context was full — compacted the conversation and retrying…
agent.localBaseUrlHint: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama); models are discovered automatically.
agent.contextUsageHint: {{percent}}% of the model's context window (≈{{tokens}} / {{limit}} tokens). Oldest turns are folded into a summary past {{threshold}}%.
agent.autoFixLimitReached: Auto-fix paused after {{count}} consecutive failed renders — review the source yourself, or send a message to continue.

welcome.tagline: A local-first JSXGraph workbench — write JavaScript on the left, see the interactive drawing on the right.
welcome.f1Desc: Type JSXGraph JavaScript and see the interactive figure rendered instantly — no server round-trip.
welcome.f2Desc: Describe the drawing in chat; the agent writes the JSXGraph code, renders it, and verifies it works.
welcome.f3Desc: Documents and chat sessions live only on this device. Bring your own keys; no server, no account.
